title: ""
pagetitle: "Financial Dashboard"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: yeti
---

<!--
Financial Dashboard. No API keys: the data file docs/data/markets.json is
built by scripts/update_market_data.py (Yahoo Finance prices, FRED public
CSVs) and refreshed every day by the GitHub Action in
.github/workflows/update-markets.yml. The charts are drawn in the browser.
-->

```{=html}
<style>
.fd{--blue:#3d6fd6;--blue-lt:#a8c5f7;--red:#e07a7a;--yellow:#f2c46d;--green:#4f9d69;--ink:#2d3a4a;--muted:#6b7686;--line:#e6e9ef;
    font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto}
.fd h1{font:600 1.7rem Georgia,serif;margin:.4rem 0 .1rem}
.fd .accent{height:4px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e8a0a0,#f2c46d 45%,#a8c5f7);margin:.3rem 0 .6rem;opacity:.8}
.fd .live .tradingview-widget-container{width:80%!important;transform:scale(1.25);transform-origin:0 0;margin-bottom:18px}
.fd .live{border:1px solid #f1e3bd;border-left:4px solid #f2c46d;background:#fefaf0;border-radius:10px;padding:.3rem .6rem;margin:.2rem 0 .6rem;min-height:72px}
.fd .debtclock{border:1px solid #f1d0d0;border-left:4px solid #e07a7a;background:#fdf6f5;border-radius:10px;padding:.6rem 1rem;margin-bottom:12px;text-align:center}
.fd .debtclock .lab{font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#b25a5a;font-weight:700}
.fd .debtclock .num{font:700 2.4rem/1.15 "SFMono-Regular",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;color:#c0392b;letter-spacing:.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin:.15rem 0}
@media(max-width:700px){.fd .debtclock .num{font-size:1.5rem}}
.fd .debtclock .meta{font-size:.76rem;color:var(--muted)}
.fd .tile{border:1px solid #f1e3bd;border-left:4px solid #f2c46d;background:#fefaf0;border-radius:10px;padding:.5rem .9rem;height:96px;overflow:hidden}
.fd .tile .k{font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#8a7338;font-weight:600}
.fd .tile .big{font:600 1.8rem Georgia,serif;line-height:1.15;margin:.15rem 0}
.fd .tile .tradingview-widget-container{margin:-4px -12px 0}
.fd .tile .meta{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}
.fd .tile .dot{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#4f9d69;margin-right:.35rem;animation:fdp 2s infinite}
@keyframes fdp{50%{opacity:.25}}
.fd .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.fd .strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.3rem .9rem;padding:.45rem .8rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fafbfd;margin-bottom:.6rem;font-size:.8rem}
.fd .strip b{font-weight:600}.fd .up{color:var(--green)}.fd .dn{color:#c75b5b}
.fd .ctrl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:.45rem;margin:.3rem 0 1rem}
.fd .ctrl .lab{font-size:.88rem;color:#6b7686}
.fd .paradigm{text-align:center;max-width:860px;margin:1.6rem auto 1.7rem;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink);padding:.55rem 1rem;border-top:1px solid #f5dfa6;border-bottom:1px solid #f5dfa6}
.fd .paradigm b{color:#b0833a}
.fd .paradigm .ph{font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;color:#b0833a;text-align:center;margin-bottom:.35rem}
.fd .ctrl button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:.32rem .85rem;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
.fd .ctrl button.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.fd .ctrl button:hover,.fd .explorer .tabs button:hover{background:#fdf3d8}
.fd .ctrl .sep{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--line);margin:0 .3rem}
.fd h2{font:600 1.05rem system-ui,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--blue);margin:1rem 0 .6rem;border:0;padding-bottom:.25rem;border-bottom:2px solid #f5dfa6;display:inline-block}
.fd .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(340px,1fr));gap:14px}
.fd .card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:.7rem .8rem .5rem;background:#fff}
.fd .card .t{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:.5rem}
.fd .card .n{font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem}
.fd .card .v{font-weight:600;font-size:1.05rem;white-space:nowrap}
.fd .card .c{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);margin:.1rem 0 .3rem}
.fd .card canvas{width:100%!important;height:190px!important}
.fd .explorer{grid-column:1/-1;border-top:3px solid #f5dfa6}
.fd .explorer .t .v{font-size:2rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.01em}
.fd .explorer .t .n{font-size:1.05rem}
.fd .explorer .tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.3rem;margin:.3rem 0 .5rem}
.fd .explorer .tabs button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:.2rem .65rem;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
.fd .explorer .tabs button.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.fd .explorer .tabs button.pair.on{background:#d9736f;border-color:#d9736f}
.fd .explorer .tabs .lab{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;align-self:center;margin-right:.2rem}
.fd .explorer canvas{height:330px!important}
.fd .foot{color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem;margin:1.2rem 0 2rem}
</style>

<div class="fd">
  <h1>Financial Dashboard</h1>
  <div class="accent"></div>
  <div class="sub" id="fd-updated">Loading data…</div>
  <div class="live">
    <div class="tradingview-widget-container"><div class="tradingview-widget-container__widget"></div>
    <script type="text/javascript" src="https://s3.tradingview.com/external-embedding/embed-widget-tickers.js" async>
    {"symbols": [{"proName": "COINBASE:BTCUSD", "title": "Bitcoin (live, 24/7)"}, {"proName": "CAPITALCOM:US500", "title": "S&P 500 futures (live)"}],
     "isTransparent": true, "showSymbolLogo": true, "colorTheme": "light", "locale": "en"}
    </script></div>
  </div>
  <div class="strip" id="fd-strip"></div>
  <div class="paradigm"><div class="ph">Current Market Paradigm <i>September 28, 2026</i></div>Rates remain restrictive but the market prevails while bonds are waving the white flag and saying something's got to give. Inflation expectations remain high, but deflation narratives could take over quickly after the AI buildout. Finished rotation out of Silver and Uranium into the mid-term year Q4 bottom of the bear for crypto. Currently dollar cost averaging into key assets of the future with a focus on BTC, Crypto, AI, and Space. Silver, Copper, and Uranium remain safe commodity plays that should outperform the S&amp;P, and Broadcom is the current safe AI play which does not yet have a crazy P/E, but aiming for these only up to 1/4 of portfolio as core positions. Looking for LEAP opportunities on those assets, and using a rotational model to layer in and layer out at key regression levels. Hold and stack only for now.</div>
  <div class="ctrl">
    <span class="lab">Timeframe</span>
    <button data-tf="D" class="on">Daily</button><button data-tf="W">Weekly</button><button data-tf="M">Monthly</button>
    <span class="sep"></span>
    <span class="lab">Range</span>
    <button data-r="1">1Y</button><button data-r="3" class="on">3Y</button><button data-r="5">5Y</button><button data-r="0">All</button>
    <span class="sep"></span>
    <button id="fd-log" class="on">Log scale (prices)</button>
  </div>
  <h2>Markets</h2>
  <div class="grid" id="fd-prices"></div>
  <h2>Economy</h2>
  <div class="debtclock"><div class="lab">U.S. National Debt</div>
    <div class="num" id="fd-debt">$—</div>
    <div class="meta" id="fd-debt-meta">Treasury, Debt to the Penny</div></div>
  <div class="grid" id="fd-macro"></div>
  <div class="foot">Prices: Yahoo Finance daily closes. Economic data: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED): FEDFUNDS, DGS10, DGS30, DGS2, WALCL, ICSA, CPIAUCSL, GDPC1, UNRATE, M2SL, PAYEMS, GFDEBTN, T10Y2Y, GDP. Ratios compare closing prices on days both traded. Live bitcoin: Coinbase. Live S&amp;P 500: TradingView (Capital.com US500, which tracks the E-mini ES futures; CME does not allow ES1! itself in website widgets). Debt clock: U.S. Treasury, Debt to the Penny, extended at its past-year pace. ShadowStats-style line is an estimate (official CPI + 7 points; Saville, TSI Blog, 2015), not ShadowStats data. Updated automatically every 15 minutes. Not investment advice.</div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var years = 3, tf = "D", logScale = true, DATA = null, charts = [];
  var FEATURED = [];
  var SINGLES = ["BTC-USD", "SPY", "SOL-USD", "MSTR", "TSLA", "SPCX", "AVGO", "AMD", "NVDA", "MU", "FWDI", "DFDV", "UPXI", "MP", "BZ=F", "GC=F", "SLV", "SILJ", "UUUU", "HG=F", "ETH-USD"];
  var PAIRS = [["MSTR", "BTC-USD"], ["SOL-USD", "BTC-USD"], ["SOL-USD", "DFDV"], ["AVGO", "MU"], ["AVGO", "NVDA"], ["NVDA", "MU"], ["TSLA", "SPCX"], ["SLV", "GLD"], ["HG=F", "SLV"], ["SPY", "GLD"], ["SOL-USD", "ETH-USD"]];
  var SHORT = {"BTC-USD": "BTC", "SOL-USD": "SOL", "BZ=F": "Brent", "GC=F": "Gold", "HG=F": "Copper", "ETH-USD": "ETH"};
  var sel = "BTC-USD";
  function sn(sym) { return SHORT[sym] || sym; }
  function ratio(a, b) {           // a / b on the dates both traded
    var m = {}; DATA.prices[b].points.forEach(function (p) { m[p[0]] = p[1]; });
    return DATA.prices[a].points.filter(function (p) { return m[p[0]]; }).map(function (p) { return [p[0], +(p[1] / m[p[0]]).toPrecision(5)]; });
  }
  var fmtMoney = function (v) { return v >= 1000 ? "$" + v.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 0}) : "$" + v.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: v < 10 ? 3 : 2}); };
  var MACRO_FMT = {
    cpi_yoy: function (v) { return v.toFixed(1) + "%"; }, cpi_cum: function (v) { return "+" + v.toFixed(1) + "%"; }, unrate: function (v) { return v.toFixed(1) + "%"; },
    t10y2y: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2) + " pts"; }, debt_gdp: function (v) { return v.toFixed(1) + "%"; },
    m2: function (v) { return "$" + v.toFixed(2) + "T"; }, debt: function (v) { return "$" + v.toFixed(2) + "T"; },
    real_gdp: function (v) { return "$" + v.toFixed(2) + "T"; },
    payrolls: function (v) { return (v >= 0 ? "+" : "") + Math.round(v).toLocaleString() + "K"; },
    fedfunds: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2) + "%"; }, dgs10: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2) + "%"; },
    dgs30: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2) + "%"; }, dgs2: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2) + "%"; }, shadow: function (v) { return "~" + v.toFixed(1) + "%"; },
    walcl: function (v) { return "$" + v.toFixed(2) + "T"; }, icsa: function (v) { return Math.round(v) + "K"; },
    sahm: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2); }
  };
  function cut(points) {
    if (!years) return points;
    var d = new Date(points[points.length - 1][0]); d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() - years);
    var s = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    return points.filter(function (p) { return p[0] >= s; });
  }
  // Weekly / monthly timeframe: keep the last value in each week (Mon-Sun) or month
  function resample(points) {
    if (tf === "D") return points;
    var out = [], key = null;
    points.forEach(function (p) {
      var k;
      if (tf === "M") k = p[0].slice(0, 7);
      else { var d = new Date(p[0] + "T00:00:00Z"); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() - ((d.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7)); k = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
      if (k === key) out[out.length - 1] = p; else { out.push(p); key = k; }
    });
    return out;
  }
  function pctChange(points, daysBack) {
    var last = points[points.length - 1], d = new Date(last[0]); d.setDate(d.getDate() - daysBack);
    var s = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10), base = null;
    for (var i = points.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (points[i][0] <= s) { base = points[i]; break; } }
    return base ? (last[1] / base[1] - 1) * 100 : null;
  }
  function chg(p) { return p == null ? "" : '<span class="' + (p >= 0 ? "up" : "dn") + '">' + (p >= 0 ? "+" : "") + p.toFixed(1) + "%</span>"; }
  function card(el, id, title, value, note) {
    var c = document.createElement("div"); c.className = "card";
    c.innerHTML = '<div class="t"><span class="n">' + title + '</span><span class="v">' + value + '</span></div><div class="c">' + note + '</div><canvas id="' + id + '"></canvas>';
    el.appendChild(c); return document.getElementById(id);
  }
  function draw(canvas, points, opts) {
    var pts = resample(cut(points));
    var bar = opts.bar, color = opts.color || "#3d6fd6";
    return new Chart(canvas, {
      type: bar ? "bar" : "line",
      data: { labels: pts.map(function (p) { return p[0]; }),
              datasets: [{ data: pts.map(function (p) { return p[1]; }), borderColor: color, borderWidth: 1.6, pointRadius: 0, tension: 0.1,
                           backgroundColor: bar ? pts.map(function (p) { return p[1] >= 0 ? "#a8c5f7" : "#e07a7a"; }) : (opts.fill || "rgba(61,111,214,0.08)"), fill: !bar }] },
      options: {
        animation: false, responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
        interaction: { mode: "index", intersect: false },
        plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function (c) { return opts.fmt(c.parsed.y); } } } },
        scales: {
          x: { ticks: { maxTicksLimit: 5, maxRotation: 0, color: "#6b7686", font: { size: 10 }, callback: function (v) { var l = this.getLabelForValue(v); return l.slice(0, years && years <= 3 ? 7 : 4); } }, grid: { display: false } },
          y: { type: opts.log ? "logarithmic" : "linear", position: "right", ticks: { maxTicksLimit: 5, color: "#6b7686", font: { size: 10 },
               callback: function (v) { return opts.axis ? opts.axis(v) : v; } }, grid: { color: "#f0f2f6" } }
        }
      }
    });
  }
  function render() {
    charts.forEach(function (c) { c.destroy(); }); charts = [];
    var P = document.getElementById("fd-prices"), M = document.getElementById("fd-macro");
    P.innerHTML = ""; M.innerHTML = "";
    FEATURED.forEach(function (sym, i) {
      var s = DATA.prices[sym], pts = s.points, last = pts[pts.length - 1];
      var cv = card(P, "p" + i, s.name, fmtMoney(last[1]), "1D " + chg(pctChange(pts, 1)) + " &nbsp; 1Y " + chg(pctChange(pts, 365)) + " &nbsp; as of " + last[0]);
      charts.push(draw(cv, pts, { log: logScale, fmt: fmtMoney, axis: function (v) { return v >= 1000 ? "$" + (v / 1000).toFixed(v >= 10000 ? 0 : 1) + "k" : "$" + v; } }));
    });
    // Explorer: one chart, click between tickers and pairs
    var ex = document.createElement("div"); ex.className = "card explorer";
    var isPair = sel.indexOf("/") > 0, pts, title, val, note, f;
    if (isPair) {
      var ab = sel.split("/"); pts = ratio(ab[0], ab[1]);
      title = sn(ab[0]) + " / " + sn(ab[1]) + " ratio";
      f = function (v) { return v.toPrecision(4); };
      note = "How many " + sn(ab[1]) + " one " + sn(ab[0]) + " buys. Rising = " + sn(ab[0]) + " outperforming. 1Y " + chg(pctChange(pts, 365));
    } else {
      pts = DATA.prices[sel].points; title = DATA.prices[sel].name; f = fmtMoney;
      note = "1D " + chg(pctChange(pts, 1)) + " &nbsp; 1Y " + chg(pctChange(pts, 365)) + " &nbsp; as of " + pts[pts.length - 1][0];
    }
    val = f(pts[pts.length - 1][1]);
    ex.innerHTML = '<div class="t"><span class="n">' + title + '</span><span class="v">' + val + '</span></div><div class="c">' + note + '</div>' +
      '<div class="tabs"><span class="lab">Tickers</span>' + SINGLES.map(function (k) { return '<button data-k="' + k + '"' + (k === sel ? ' class="on"' : '') + '>' + sn(k) + '</button>'; }).join("") + '</div>' +
      '<div class="tabs"><span class="lab">Pairs</span>' + PAIRS.map(function (p) { var k = p[0] + "/" + p[1]; return '<button class="pair' + (k === sel ? ' on' : '') + '" data-k="' + k + '">' + sn(p[0]) + "/" + sn(p[1]) + '</button>'; }).join("") + '</div>' +
      '<canvas id="ex"></canvas>';
    P.appendChild(ex);
    ex.querySelectorAll("button[data-k]").forEach(function (b) { b.onclick = function () { sel = b.dataset.k; render(); }; });
    charts.push(draw(document.getElementById("ex"), pts, { log: logScale, fmt: f, color: isPair ? "#d9736f" : "#3d6fd6", fill: isPair ? "rgba(224,122,122,0.08)" : "rgba(61,111,214,0.08)", axis: isPair ? function (v) { return (+v).toPrecision(3); } : function (v) { return v >= 1000 ? "$" + (v / 1000).toFixed(v >= 10000 ? 0 : 1) + "k" : "$" + v; } }));

    var ORDER = ["debt_gdp", "cpi_cum", "cpi_yoy", "shadow", "fedfunds", "walcl", "unrate", "icsa", "payrolls", "real_gdp", "m2", "debt", "dgs10", "dgs30", "dgs2", "t10y2y"];
    ORDER.filter(function (k) { return DATA.macro[k]; }).forEach(function (k, i) {
      var s = DATA.macro[k], pts = s.points, last = pts[pts.length - 1], f = MACRO_FMT[k] || function (v) { return v; };
      var cv = card(M, "m" + i, s.name, f(last[1]), s.unit + " &nbsp;·&nbsp; latest " + last[0]);
      var warm = ["fedfunds", "dgs10", "dgs30", "dgs2", "cpi_yoy", "cpi_cum", "shadow", "unrate", "icsa", "debt", "debt_gdp"].indexOf(k) >= 0;   // stress gauges in faded red
      charts.push(draw(cv, pts, { bar: k === "payrolls", fmt: f, axis: null, color: warm ? "#d9736f" : "#3d6fd6", fill: warm ? "rgba(224,122,122,0.07)" : "rgba(61,111,214,0.08)" }));
    });
  }
  function strip() {
    document.getElementById("fd-strip").innerHTML = Object.keys(DATA.prices).map(function (sym) {
      var pts = DATA.prices[sym].points; return "<span id=\"st-" + sym + "\"><b>" + sn(sym) + "</b> " + fmtMoney(pts[pts.length - 1][1]) + " " + chg(pctChange(pts, 1)) + "</span>";
    }).join("");
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".fd .ctrl button[data-tf]").forEach(function (b) {
    b.onclick = function () { document.querySelectorAll(".fd .ctrl button[data-tf]").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); }); b.classList.add("on"); tf = b.dataset.tf; render(); };
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".fd .ctrl button[data-r]").forEach(function (b) {
    b.onclick = function () { document.querySelectorAll(".fd .ctrl button[data-r]").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); }); b.classList.add("on"); years = +b.dataset.r; render(); };
  });
  document.getElementById("fd-log").onclick = function () { logScale = !logScale; this.classList.toggle("on", logScale); render(); };
  // Live crypto prices from Coinbase (public), refreshed every minute into the price strip
  function cryptoLive() {
    ["BTC-USD", "SOL-USD"].forEach(function (sym) {
      fetch("https://api.exchange.coinbase.com/products/" + sym + "/stats").then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
        var el = document.getElementById("st-" + sym); if (!el) return;
        el.innerHTML = "<b>" + sn(sym) + "</b> " + fmtMoney(+d.last) + " " + chg((+d.last / +d.open - 1) * 100) + ' <span style="color:#8a7338;font-size:.7rem">live</span>';
      }).catch(function () {});
    });
  }
  setInterval(cryptoLive, 60000);
  // Debt clock: latest Treasury "Debt to the Penny" figure, run forward at its average pace over the past year
  function debtClock(dc) {
    if (!dc) return;
    var t0 = Date.parse(dc.latest[0] + "T00:00:00Z"), v0 = dc.latest[1];
    var perMs = (v0 - dc.year_ago[1]) / (t0 - Date.parse(dc.year_ago[0] + "T00:00:00Z"));
    var el = document.getElementById("fd-debt");
    document.getElementById("fd-debt-meta").innerHTML = "Rising about $" + Math.round(perMs * 1000).toLocaleString() + " per second (past-year average) &nbsp;·&nbsp; last official figure $" +
      (v0 / 1e12).toFixed(3) + "T on " + dc.latest[0] + " (U.S. Treasury, Debt to the Penny)";
    (function tick() { el.textContent = "$" + Math.round(v0 + perMs * (Date.now() - t0)).toLocaleString("en-US"); setTimeout(tick, 60); })();
  }
  fetch("data/markets.json?v=" + Date.now()).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
    DATA = d; document.getElementById("fd-updated").textContent = "Updated " + d.updated + " · market data refreshed every 15 minutes; bitcoin and S&P futures stream live";
    strip(); render(); cryptoLive(); debtClock(d.debt_clock);
  }).catch(function () { document.getElementById("fd-updated").textContent = "Data could not be loaded."; });
})();
</script>
```
